description: Manual ground-truth track classifications for controlled demonstration and validation of the child safety policy in a residential driveway environment (Scenario B). These labels are for testing and evaluation only, NOT for operational surveillance or autonomous demographic profiling.
provisional_ground_truth_notice: Track 2 is manually designated as PROVISIONAL ground-truth child annotation specifically for this synthetic evaluation experiment. Actual ground truth cannot be independently verified from demo video metadata, and visual appearance age inference is strictly NOT performed.

1.notes: Adult pedestrian walking/standing on dedicated sidewalk. Strictly excluded from child alerts.

2.notes: Provisional ground truth: child walking on sidewalk, stepping into vehicular driveway lane, and dwelling > 2 seconds before returning to sidewalk. Manually assigned for synthetic experiment validation; cannot be independently established from demo metadata.

discontinuity_policy.handling: Track IDs are ephemeral ByteTrack assignments and not permanent identities. Unannotated or reassigned IDs strictly default to UNCLASSIFIED with no automatic annotation inheritance.
